acquisition method: acquired with an Orbitrap Q Exactive mass spectrometer (Thermo Scientific) in a data-dependent manner using a top-20 method.
alkylation reagent: protein extracts were reduced and alkylated via incubation with 10 mm of DTT and iodoacetamide, respectively.
alkylation concentration: protein extracts were reduced and alkylated via incubation with 10 mm of DTT and iodoacetamide, respectively.
cleavage agent: Proteins (80 μg) were digested with trypsin and incubated at 37 °C for 9 h.
collision energy: Peptide fragmentation was performed via higher-energy collisional dissociation set at 25 V of normalized collisional energy.
fractionation method: enabled analysis of over 5000 human proteins in single-dimensional LC-MS/MS shotgun experiments
fragmentation method: Peptide fragmentation was performed via higher-energy collisional dissociation set at 25 V of normalized collisional energy.
instrument: Mass spectra were acquired with an Orbitrap Q Exactive mass spectrometer (Thermo Scientific)
ionization type: Three micrograms of each sample was injected to Thermo Scientific EASY-Spray columns
labeling: Based on conventional data-dependent acquisition strategy of shotgun proteomics
reduction reagent: protein extracts were reduced and alkylated via incubation with 10 mm of DTT and iodoacetamide, respectively.
reduction concentration: protein extracts were reduced and alkylated via incubation with 10 mm of DTT and iodoacetamide, respectively.
